QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Invitation
QuestInfo.0: How should you go about preparing for the Continental Conference? Talk to Neinheart to find out.
QuestInfo.1: The Empress is sending representatives to every potential ally in Maple World. Neinheart wants you to approach the Resistance.
QuestInfo.2: You met Claudine, the head of the Resistance, in Edelstein.
